<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="invention-basics-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Invention Basics Guide </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: a </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> can be found in the pinned messages.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Invention, the only </nowiki><strong><nowiki>elite skill</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in the game, is one of the best ways to easily increase your DPS </nowiki><em><nowiki>and</nowiki></em><nowiki> defences, as well as provide a ton of utility. As such, it is </nowiki><em><nowiki>very</nowiki></em><nowiki> important to unlock and train it as soon as possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide will cover the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Unlocking Invention</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Materials (parts and components)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gizmos &amp; Perks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Adding gizmos to items</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Augmentation &amp; item levels</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Invention machines</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tech trees - Dwarven/Goblin</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ancient Invention</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Training methods</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tips &amp; tricks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you are just looking for information on what perks you should use, check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perk-information</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="unlocking-invention"><ins><nowiki>Unlocking Invention</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="requirements"><nowiki>Requirements</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Unlocking Invention has the following requirements:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Smithing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864814379466812.png?v=1" alt="smithing" title="smithing" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Crafting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039864810239705119.png?v=1" alt="crafting" title="crafting" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 80 Divination </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1042453694735712286.png?v=1" alt="divination" title="divination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="unlocking-invention_1"><nowiki>Unlocking Invention</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ First head to the Invention guild located just north of Falador (around the Dwarven mines area).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Bq1tAou.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Next go to talk to the dwarf inside called Doc.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1u8quO8.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Doc will walk you through a basic Invention tutorial that shows you how to augment items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-inventors-workbench"><ins><nowiki>The Inventor's Workbench</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="using-the-workbench"><nowiki>Using the Workbench</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is where you'll manufacture most of the items Invention gives you access to.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each bench has two click options: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>discover</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>manufacture</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You must first </nowiki><strong><nowiki>discover</nowiki></strong><nowiki> an item before you can </nowiki><strong><nowiki>manufacture</nowiki></strong><nowiki> it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/VcjjxMr.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="discovery-tab"><nowiki>Discovery Tab</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This is the screen you'll see when you open the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Discover</nowiki></em><nowiki> tab.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/L1xzFwg.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ On the left, there are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>blueprints</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, corresponding to Invention items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A blueprint must be successfully 'completed' before the corresponding item is accessible to you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Selecting a blueprint brings up a small minigame:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You first select 5 modules (through trial and error) from 10 options to find the ones that work.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Then you arrange them into order to successfully unlock items, which gives some </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> experience.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/R5unsHe.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Note:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The modules can be placed in </nowiki><em><nowiki>any</nowiki></em><nowiki> order (but correct orders give up to 5x more </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> experience).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The different levels of success are: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Poor &lt; Satisfactory &lt; Good &lt; Excellent &lt; Perfect</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/7q46xXN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once you have discovered items, you can manufacture them using the other side of the workbench.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="manufacturing-tab"><nowiki>Manufacturing Tab</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The right side of the bench allows you to manufacture invention items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/PCvnhmH9DF.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ This includes things like divine charges </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1" alt="divinecharge" title="divinecharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, gizmos </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1" alt="ancientweapongizmo" title="ancientweapongizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1" alt="ancientarmourgizmo" title="ancientarmourgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1" alt="ancienttoolgizmo" title="ancienttoolgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, invention items </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1" alt="augmentor" title="augmentor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869649975787580.png?v=1" alt="gizmodissolver" title="gizmodissolver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869647677313144.png?v=1" alt="augmentationdissolver" title="augmentationdissolver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869642455404594.png?v=1" alt="equipmentseperator" title="equipmentseperator" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, certain augmented items </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846948570267648.png?v=1" alt="sirenicbody" title="sirenicbody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643846938537623564.png?v=1" alt="sireniclegs" title="sireniclegs" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><em><nowiki>and much more</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="materials"><ins><nowiki>Materials</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-are-materials"><nowiki>What Are Materials</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Materials are parts and components used in the creation of all Invention items and perks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You get them primarily from disassembling things.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 4 types of materials: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>common</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>uncommon</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>rare</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>ancient</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can check what materials you have by clicking on the aforementioned icon. Items can also be disassembled by dragging them to this icon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/96igPYd.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ As you start collecting materials, they will be filled into your invention pouch, looking something like this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/M0Oc0Ey.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="obtaining-from-the-grand-exchange"><nowiki>Obtaining from the Grand Exchange</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Click on any material name to be linked to the calculator for best items to disassemble.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set your Junk Reduction chance according to your level</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use the sort buttons under &quot;Cost per mat&quot; to sort from lowest to highest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ignore any items that have a low value for the &quot;Trade vol.&quot; column</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pay attention to the &quot;Mats per hour&quot; column as you go down the list and consider the time/money tradeoff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For convenience, the following lists are compiled by balancing the above factors at zero junk chance reduction. Higher level players are encouraged to use the calculators themselves as the increased junk chance reduction may make other items better for disassembly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><ins><nowiki>Common Components</nowiki></ins></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183448330270.png?v=1" alt="baseparts" title="baseparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Base <strong><nowiki>Base</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Medium/large bladed adamant salvage, Royal/broad-tipped bolts, Dragonhide shields</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183465238536.png?v=1" alt="bladeparts" title="bladeparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Blade <strong><nowiki>Blade</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Steel+ darts, Adamant javelins, Guthix mjolnirs, Medium/large bladed adamant salvage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183674953728.png?v=1" alt="clearparts" title="clearparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Clear <strong><nowiki>Clear</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Air/water/earth/fire/unpowered orbs, Rubies</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434183200866321.png?v=1" alt="connectorparts" title="connectorparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Connector <strong><nowiki>Connector</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Black/green salamanders, Magic stocks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434318848720906.png?v=1" alt="coverparts" title="coverparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Cover <strong><nowiki>Cover</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Huge plated steel salvage, Small plated mithril salvage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317347291138.png?v=1" alt="craftedparts" title="craftedparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Crafted <strong><nowiki>Crafted</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Flatpacks (carved teak magic wardrobe/mahogany table), Potions (Powerburst of feats (4), Zamorak brew (3), Antipoison++ (4)), Black/green salamanders</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317431046155.png?v=1" alt="crystalparts" title="crystalparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Crystal <strong><nowiki>Crystal</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Crystal teleport seeds (kill Lletya elves and recharge), Crystal tools (via tool seeds)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317644955648.png?v=1" alt="deflectingparts" title="deflectingparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Deflecting <strong><nowiki>Deflecting</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Huge plated steel salvage, Small plated mithril salvage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317301022723.png?v=1" alt="delicateparts" title="delicateparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Delicate <strong><nowiki>Delicate</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Air/water/earth/fire/unpowered orbs, Potions (Powerburst of feats (4), Zamorak brew (3), Antipoison++ (4))</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317699743754.png?v=1" alt="flexibleparts" title="flexibleparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Flexible <strong><nowiki>Flexible</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Maple+ shortbows (includes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026263191563.png?v=1" alt="dextrouscomp" title="dextrouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) or shieldbows (includes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604632080387.png?v=1" alt="strongcomp" title="strongcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317686898716.png?v=1" alt="headparts" title="headparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Head <strong><nowiki>Head</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Steel+ arrows, Royal/broad-tipped bolts</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336263602187.png?v=1" alt="magicparts" title="magicparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Magic <strong><nowiki>Magic</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Body/death runes, Portent of restoration VIII/IX</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336553140224.png?v=1" alt="metallicparts" title="metallicparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Metallic <strong><nowiki>Metallic</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Medium/large bladed adamant salvage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434337182154764.png?v=1" alt="organicparts" title="organicparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Organic <strong><nowiki>Organic</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Cooked menaphos fish/eeligators/lobsters/swordfish</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336397688834.png?v=1" alt="paddedparts" title="paddedparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Padded <strong><nowiki>Padded</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Dragonhide armour (blue chaps/bodies have good trade volume), Battlestaves</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434336737427475.png?v=1" alt="platedparts" title="platedparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Plated <strong><nowiki>Plated</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Huge plated steel salvage, Small plated mithril salvage</nowiki></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203842473525248.png?v=1" alt="noxiouscomp" title="noxiouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Noxious <strong><nowiki>Noxious</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Noxious equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026229506058.png?v=1" alt="oceaniccomp" title="oceaniccomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Oceanic <strong><nowiki>Oceanic</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Seasinger's equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435544088936491.png?v=1" alt="pestiferouscomp" title="pestiferouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Pestiferous <strong><nowiki>Pestiferous</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Korasi's sword, Void knight equpiment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435452556640259.png?v=1" alt="resilientcomp" title="resilientcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Resilient <strong><nowiki>Resilient</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Masuta's warspear, Mizuyari, Tetsu equipment, Dinosaurhide armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435452225421347.png?v=1" alt="rumblingcomp" title="rumblingcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Rumbling <strong><nowiki>Rumbling</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Drygore weapons, Raids armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429785632769.png?v=1" alt="saradomincomp" title="saradomincomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Saradomin <strong><nowiki>Saradomin</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Saradomin mjolnirs, Saradomin's whisper/hiss/murmur</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429877907456.png?v=1" alt="serencomp" title="serencomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Seren <strong><nowiki>Seren</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Attuned crystal equipment, Crystal equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583428397318012938.png?v=1" alt="shadowcomp" title="shadowcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Shadow <strong><nowiki>Shadow</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Gregorovic's drops (</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shadow_components#Methods_of_obtaining <nowiki>compare methods</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429978570763.png?v=1" alt="shiftingcomp" title="shiftingcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Shifting <strong><nowiki>Shifting</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Khopesh of the Kharidian, Chaotic weapons</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429563465730.png?v=1" alt="silentcomp" title="silentcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Silent <strong><nowiki>Silent</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Death lotus darts, Death lotus extract (DG reward shop: 5k tokens each), Death lotus equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583428397204766783.png?v=1" alt="thirdagecomp" title="thirdagecomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Third-age <strong><nowiki>Third-age</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Third Age equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583428397397573659.png?v=1" alt="undeadcomp" title="undeadcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Undead <strong><nowiki>Undead</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Malevolent equipment, Linza's equipment</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026334232576.png?v=1" alt="zamorakcomp" title="zamorakcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Zamorak <strong><nowiki>Zamorak</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Ward of subjugation, Zamorak mjolnirs, Warpriest of Zamorak armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429949341697.png?v=1" alt="zaroscomp" title="zaroscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Disassembly_by_material/Zaros <strong><nowiki>Zaros</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> - Nex's drops, Ancient defenders</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ancient-materials"><nowiki>Ancient Materials</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ancient materials can be bought in crates directly from the Grand Exchange.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405254676906018.png?v=1" alt="historiccomps" title="historiccomps" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Historic_components <strong><nowiki>Historic</nowiki></strong>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405254337167401.png?v=1" alt="classiccomps" title="classiccomps" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Classic_components <strong><nowiki>Classic</nowiki></strong>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405254098092063.png?v=1" alt="vintagecomps" title="vintagecomps" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vintage_components <strong><nowiki>Vintage</nowiki></strong>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405254265864244.png?v=1" alt="timeworncomps" title="timeworncomps" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Timeworn_components <strong><nowiki>Timeworn</nowiki></strong>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="other-methods"><nowiki>Other Methods</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Uncommon and rare components can also be passively gained through combat from the Scavenging </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to add Scavenging 2 (5 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1" alt="preciouscomp" title="preciouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) to a piece of armour at low </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to start passively obtaining uncommon components as some of these are troublesome to get otherwise.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be upgraded to Scavenging 4 (9 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434604724224008.png?v=1" alt="preciouscomp" title="preciouscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) upon unlocking Ancient Invention and placed on a piece of slayer armour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><span><nowiki>#scavenging-farming</nowiki></span><nowiki> if wanting to specifically amass components via Scavenging</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some shops also provide a supply of items to disassemble at rates below the GE value. This may be especially useful for ironmen accounts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Warriors' Guild Armoury</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• White Knight Master Armoury</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Killing monsters for untradable drops is a cheaper method of obtaining certain components</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing Armadyl or Zamorak spiritual warriors in a Player-Owned Slayer Dungeon provides a supply of unowned warpriest armour for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158477033474.png?v=1" alt="armadylcomp" title="armadylcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026334232576.png?v=1" alt="zamorakcomp" title="zamorakcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> components</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing elves in Lletya provides Crystal teleport seeds that may be recharged at Eluned/Islwyn and disassembled for cheap and quick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583434317431046155.png?v=1" alt="crystalparts" title="crystalparts" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026355466299.png?v=1" alt="facetedcomp" title="facetedcomp" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="gizmos-and-perks"><ins><nowiki>Gizmos and Perks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Gizmos are the main focus of invention. They allow you to put perks on your weapons, armour and tools which allow for some very useful effects during skilling or PvM.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="making-gizmos"><nowiki>Making Gizmos</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are separate gizmos for tools </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1" alt="ancienttoolgizmo" title="ancienttoolgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, weapons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1" alt="ancientweapongizmo" title="ancientweapongizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1" alt="ancientarmourgizmo" title="ancientarmourgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> each needing to be discovered at the workbench.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Unlock gizmos by discovering their blueprints at the following levels:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon gizmos - level 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Armour gizmos - level 16 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tool gizmos - level 22 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can then create at the workbench if you have sufficient resources.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="adding-perks-to-gizmos"><nowiki>Adding Perks to Gizmos</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Click a gizmo to bring up the following menu:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/lpZ1nXp.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Click or drag materials to fill the slots on the top right. This will fill them with the selected material.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Depending on the materials used and their layout, the possible perk results are shown on the bottom right.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Click </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Create</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to create the gizmo.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/H3qQ2F9.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Each gizmo can hold up to 2 perks.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is why most endgame PvM perks are a combo of two perks - this maximises the number of perks you can have</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. a single gizmo containing Biting 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Mobile </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Keep in mind:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not all perks are guaranteed outcomes. Be prepared to try multiple times in some cases.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Perks with multiple ranks will be more effective at higher ranks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g. Biting 1 gives 2% crit chance, Biting 4 gives +8% crit chance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>You should wait to get expensive endgame perks at level 120 Invention.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="adding-gizmos-to-items"><ins><nowiki>Adding Gizmos to Items</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gizmos can only be added to augmented items, as follows:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tools</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 2 tool gizmos each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>MH and OH weapons</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 1 weapon gizmo each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2H weapons (excluding shieldbows)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 2 weapon gizmos</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Defenders</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 1 weapon OR armour gizmo</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shieldbows (e.g. strykebow, darkbow)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 1 weapon AND 1 armour gizmo</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Body/leg armours</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 2 armour gizmos each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Note: weapon and armour gizmos can be either normal or ancient. You should use ancient as soon as they're available as they offer better perks. For more detailed info, see </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ancient_Invention <nowiki>Ancient Invention</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To remove a gizmo from an item, there are a few options:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gizmo dissolvers</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869649975787580.png?v=1" alt="gizmodissolver" title="gizmodissolver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will remove a single gizmo, destroying the perks </nowiki><em><nowiki>in that gizmo</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Augmentation dissolvers</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869647677313144.png?v=1" alt="augmentationdissolver" title="augmentationdissolver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will de-augment the item, destroying </nowiki><em><nowiki>all gizmos/perks</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Equipment separators</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869642455404594.png?v=1" alt="equipmentseperator" title="equipmentseperator" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will remove and return the gizmos to you, but </nowiki><em><nowiki>require items to be level 15 or higher.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Augmented items (and the perks in them) will not work unless you have divine charges </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1" alt="divinecharge" title="divinecharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stored. You can either create them at the workbench or buy them at the GE.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="augmentation"><ins><nowiki>Augmentation</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="how-to-augment-items"><nowiki>How to Augment Items</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Items can be augmented in two ways:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>For most items</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: click Augmentor </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1" alt="augmentor" title="augmentor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → use on Item</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Degrade-to-dust items</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: take fully-repaired Item + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1" alt="divinecharge" title="divinecharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039863296729296946.png?v=1" alt="augmentor" title="augmentor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → create augmented item at Workbench</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="item-levels"><nowiki>Item Levels</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Augmented items gain experience as you use them</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, increasing their item level.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Maximum item levels can be increased by discovering blueprints:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 5 - at 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 10 - at 27 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 15 - at 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20 - at 99 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>As items increase in level, they get some benefits, notably</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 3 - disassembles for 2x materials</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 6 - disassembles for 3x materials</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 8 - gizmos are returned when disassembling</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 9 - disassembles for 4x materials</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 10 - disassembles for maximum experience</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 12 - siphons for maximum experience</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 15 - equipment separators can be used on this item</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Level 20 - perks are 10% more effective on this item</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Note that items use less charges </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1" alt="divinecharge" title="divinecharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as they level up, making them more efficient.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="machines"><ins><nowiki>Machines</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Towards the back of the Invention guild, you'll be able to create machines (starting at level 60).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ These machines can do some very handy stuff such as High Alching </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290631786496.png?v=1" alt="highalch" title="highalch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and disassembling items, and even partially processing items (e.g. logs → planks, herbs → unf potions, etc.)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Up to 5 spots for machines (pink), and one spot for a power generator (red) are available:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/An6ZlWP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking on an empty machine hotspot you'll see a list of the machines you can make and the materials/items needed to make them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/zufYzSW.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Machines are powered by divine charges</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485547598356530.png?v=1" alt="divinecharge" title="divinecharge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Charges are added to the power generator to supply power to the rest of the machines.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Machines each consume a certain level of 'power</nowiki></strong><nowiki>' - i.e. a way to limit how many machines you have at once.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This limit increases as you build better generators.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Having a tier 3 Workshop at Fort Forinthry increases the power capacity of machines by 25%.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Jumbo generator provides 160 power.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Jumbo generator with a tier 3 Workshop provides 200 power.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Machines cannot be turned on/off - to change your power allocation, you must destroy/rebuild them.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tech-trees"><ins><nowiki>Tech Trees</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-are-tech-trees"><nowiki>What Are Tech Trees</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tech trees are found on the small noticeboard next to the bank in the Invention guild.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/VLXAeM6.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ They're used to unlock additional blueprints to discover create items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Currency for unlocking blueprints can be gained by completing tasks for each tree.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tasks usually require handing in materials or finished items.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One task is added every 12h, stacking up to 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="dwarven-tech-tree"><nowiki>Dwarven Tech Tree</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following blueprints are part of the Dwarven tree:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Corporeal components</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sprinkler MK1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mining Accumulator</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Book switcher</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Calorie bomb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Auto-sanctifier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kinetic Cyclone</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dungeoneering lock melter</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="goblin-tech-tree"><nowiki>Goblin Tech Tree</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following blueprints are part of the Goblin tree:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pestiferous components</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mechanised chinchompas</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Woodcutting accumulator</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ B.A.N.K Stander</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Monkey mind-control helmet</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dungeoneering party simulator</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Electrified box trap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Oldak coil</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="ancient-invention"><ins><nowiki>Ancient Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="what-is-it"><nowiki>What Is It</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ With the release of Archaeology </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Ancient Invention was introduced to the game.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ This includes </nowiki><strong><nowiki>new tools</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (higher tier t70→t80), </nowiki><strong><nowiki>new gizmos</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1" alt="ancientweapongizmo" title="ancientweapongizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1" alt="ancientarmourgizmo" title="ancientarmourgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041619653152858.png?v=1" alt="ancienttoolgizmo" title="ancienttoolgizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>new materials &amp; perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 85 Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (boostable from 68 with an extreme potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1" alt="extremeinventionpotion" title="extremeinventionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) is required to discover, create and use ancient gizmos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ancient blueprints technically require 95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>but</nowiki></em><nowiki> blueprints and ancient materials are both tradeable on the GE.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Ironmen </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/764086050959392778.png?v=1" alt="iron" title="iron" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>cannot </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>boost for this, and will have to get the blueprints themselves at level 95.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ancient-gizmos"><nowiki>Ancient Gizmos</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ancient gizmos have 9 slots</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (vs. the regular 5 slots of normal gizmos), allowing for more perk choices and combinations.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This makes getting a starter set of perks for PvM very easy - see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Keep in mind though that as with regular gizmos, it's not worth going for high-end perks till 120 Invention.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Discovering 'perfect' rated blueprints is also a good source of XP early on.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="how-to-train-invention"><ins><nowiki>How to Train Invention</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="training-methods"><nowiki>Training Methods</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Invention is primarily trained by disassembling or siphoning augmented equipment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> once it reaches an appropriate level.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Items disassemble for full XP from level 10 or higher.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They siphon for full XP from level 12 or higher.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can siphon/disassemble at lower levels, but this gives less XP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Items gain XP and level up as you use them appropriately (combat items when fighting, skilling tools when skilling).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>In general: faster XP gain → faster item levelling → faster Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ XP Capacitors </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1039869645768884256.png?v=1" alt="xpcapacitor" title="xpcapacitor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (tradeable on the GE) should be used to double the rate of item XP gain, effectively doubling your Invention XP/hr.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="level-1-4"><nowiki>Level 1-4</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tutorial puts you at level 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="level-4-27"><nowiki>Level 4-27</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Discover item maximum level 5 blueprint.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Buy any cheap augmentable weapon (crystal halberd or black salamanders for example) and level it up to level 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 16, research augmented body armour and buy some cheap augmentable armour and level up to level 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When your weapons / armour reach level 5, disassemble them for xp. Do this until you hit level 27.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="level-27-60"><nowiki>Level 27-60</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Discover item maximum level 10 blueprint.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Continue as before but disassemble your weapons/armour at level 10 instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 45, research augmented leg armour. Buy some cheap augmentable leg armour and level it up along with your torso and weapon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="level-60"><nowiki>Level 60</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Discover item maximum level 15 blueprint.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stop using your cheap gear - augment your main gear and level it up.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At level 12, siphon the items for XP. Repeat till you reach level 120.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Invention Training Methods</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>See </nowiki><code><nowiki>!shatteredworlds</nowiki></code><nowiki> command for how to get item XP quickly.
For more detailed info, see the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training <nowiki>Wiki guide</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tips-and-tricks"><ins><nowiki>Tips and Tricks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="blueprints"><nowiki>Blueprints</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Extreme invention pots </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1" alt="extremeinventionpotion" title="extremeinventionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (requiring 85 Herblore </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="Herblore" title="Herblore" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) let you research blueprints up to 17 levels earlier.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you can't make them, use super Invention potions instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Blueprints will give double XP on DXP weekends.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="perks-materials"><nowiki>Perks &amp; Materials</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Augmentable items will disassemble for more materials at level 3 (2x), 6 (3x) and 9 (4x).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Level items up for disassembly when possible, </nowiki><em><nowiki>especially</nowiki></em><nowiki> for expensive materials.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Scavenging 3/4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005934140669046824.png?v=1" alt="scavenging4" title="scavenging4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk can add up to a lot of uncommon/rare materials over time as you PvM.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is especially noticeable when AFK farming, or doing high KPH activities like Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When going for a specific perk, always calculate the optimal way to get it in advance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
